signal.input_contract: context=2; event at decision-1ns, received/available at decision; binary value occupies history frame 0 and the scheduled-origin frame 1 is empty

censored_training_subset.selection: first eight positive-signal training examples by canonical ID

cohorts.separation: disjoint sample IDs, entity names, and decision intervals; evaluation has a separate snapshot and source pin

primary_metric: registered evaluation raw-count macro pinball, averaged over q10/q50/q90
baseline: train-only empirical unconditional quantiles on exact eligible training labels
oracle: known conditional quantiles implied by deterministic signal, expected raw-count pinball 0
decision_rule: Run once. Preserve pass or failure. Do not revise the signal, fixture, seed, recipe, or threshold after fitting.
limitations: This synthetic fixture tests conditional learnability of the implementation only.
It does not establish market forecasting ability, generalization, calibration on real data, or production eligibility.
